title: Public Law 119-126: To require the Secretary of Agriculture to convey the Pleasant Valley Ranger District Administrativ…
summary: H.R. 837, "To require the Secretary of Agriculture to convey the Pleasant Valley Ranger District Administrative Site to Gila County, Arizona.", originated in the House of the 119th Congress and became Public Law 119-126 on 2026-10-20, according to Congress.gov.
